rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１０Your answer...＝＠００１＿０１１Heh. No need to ask, is there?￥...I'm counting on you.
＊Yoh＊＠１９０＿００８Great!￥I knew you'd say yes~＝＠１９０＿００９Let's go to Elan together.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Yoh Depart　－

＊Yoh＊＠１９０＿０１４Ahh, we're really going to Elan.￥It finally feels real.＝＠１８９＿０１４Last night I was thinking back￥on everything since I got here.￥It was a lot of fun.＝＠１９０＿０１７A lot happened, but￥they were happy days.＝＠１９０＿０１８Most of all, because I met you~＝＠１９０＿０１９Still... I was sure you'd be the￥one who qualified.＝＠１９０＿０２０But even if you'd qualified,￥you'd have picked me, right?＝＠１９０＿０２１I hope so~
